scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.lint: scripts/env.sh uv run --frozen ruff check ingest finops benchmarks scripts/ci orchestration && scripts/env.sh uv run --frozen ruff format --check ingest finops benchmarks scripts/ci orchestration && scripts/env.sh terraform fmt -check -recursive infra
scripts.test:dataform: scripts/env.sh bash -c '[ -d dataform/node_modules ] || npm ci --prefix dataform --silent' && scripts/env.sh node --test --test-reporter=spec "dataform/tests/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:ci && npm run test:ingest && npm run test:finops && npm run test:infra && npm run test:dataform && npm run test:sdd && npm run test:workflows && npm run test:orchestration
